lane: لَغِيثٌ _i. q._ غَلِيثٌ, (from which it is formed by transposition, TA,) in its two meanings: (K:) _wheat mixed with barley;_ like بَغِيثٌ: (TA:) [and _food mixed with poison, by which vultures are killed_].
